examples.title: Example 1: Implementing a List Counter
examples.description: This example implements a list counter by setting type to CounterType.LIST and configuring numberOptions.

examples.title: Example 2: Implementing a Compact Counter
examples.description: This example implements a compact counter by setting type to CounterType.COMPACT and configuring numberOptions.

examples.title: Example 3: Implementing an Inline Numeric Counter
examples.description: This example implements an inline numeric counter by setting type to CounterType.INLINE and configuring inlineOptions.

examples.title: Example 4: Implementing an Inline Date Counter
examples.description: This example implements an inline date counter by setting type to CounterType.INLINE_DATE and configuring dateOptions.

examples.title: Example 5: Implementing a Mirrored Layout
examples.description: This example implements a mirrored layout for list, compact, inline numeric, and inline date counters by setting direction.
